record.title: Unavailability of Yandex Cloud Backup during maintenance work

updates.body:
The technical work has been completed, and the service is operating normally.
If you have any questions or problems, please contact technical support.

comments.content:
The technical work has been completed, and the service is operating normally.

If you have any questions or problems, please contact technical support.

Technical work is underway in the Cloud Backup service:
During the period 11:00 - 13:00 Moscow time, service operations may be unavailable for up to 45 minutes in all availability zones, including the kz1-a zone.;
During the period 13:00 - 19:00 Moscow time, it is possible to reduce the speed of creating and restoring backups in the RU availability zones.
